summary: Frontend-only regression + acceptance testing for the 7 new Egypt products slotted into the existing template. All 9 Egypt detail pages (7 new + 2 existing) load fully with title, days/cities chips, route line, price, What's-included tiles, expert card, and itinerary tabs; no broken images and no red console errors. Itinerary tab switching and 'View tour summary' glance toggle work. No horizontal overflow at 1920 or 390. Asia regression (Sri Lanka & Thailand listing) still loads. One observation: the Egypt landing /afrika/aegypten only surfaces the FIRST 6 products (products.slice(0,6)) via the existing template, with a 'View all' button routing to /afrika/aegypten/holidays where all 9 are visible. The review request expected 8 cards on /afrika/aegypten - this is a mismatch with the existing (untouched) landing template, not a functional defect.

observations.note: Landing shows only the first 6 products (existing design: products.slice(0,6) in /app/frontend/src/pages/EgyptListing.jsx line 50-79 with a 'View all' -> /afrika/aegypten/holidays). Cards rendered: Egypt Explorer, Morocco & Egypt, Egypt Grand Festival, Misr Maya, Misr Ka Jaadu, Nile Pharaohs' Voyage. Pharaohs & Feluccas, Nile Darshan, Nile Noor are NOT on landing (only on /holidays). Review request expected 8 cards on landing - either update expectation, or change landing to slice(0,9), or reorder products so priority ones appear on landing.

interactions_tested.itinerary_tab_switching: Tabs 0-3 clickable, aria-selected updates correctly on misr-maya-nile-cruise
interactions_tested.card_click_navigation: Verified via direct URL navigation for all 9 slugs; hrefs resolve correctly

action_items: Decide expected UX for /afrika/aegypten: either accept the existing '6 cards + View all' template (in which case update the review-request expectation), or expand the slice on the landing page to surface all 7 new products directly (existing code: EgyptListing.jsx line 50 `products.slice(0, 6)`).
critical_code_review_comments: EgyptListing.jsx hardcodes slice(0,6). If product count grows past 6, users must click through to /holidays to discover the rest. Consider making the listing count configurable, or ensure the ordering of products in egyptListingData.js places the marketing-priority tours in the first 6 slots.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all pages/interactions passed; landing-count is a spec mismatch, not a bug)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 new Egypt detail pages and the 2 existing ones render correctly under /afrika/aegypten/<slug>. The 9-product /holidays listing works. Only 6 cards appear on the Egypt landing by original design (EgyptListing.jsx slice(0,6)); Pharaohs & Feluccas, Nile Darshan, Nile Noor are visible only via /holidays or direct URL. No console errors, no broken images, no horizontal overflow at 1920/390.
